shared.positive: Ultra high-resolution crisp isometric digi-twin, soft studio lighting, pure flat solid #0a0c10 charcoal void, no text, no labels, no UI, no dashed boxes, no watermark, sharp edges for zoom, expanded open props (not crowded), one shared camera and lighting
shared.negative: vertical tower of three identical platforms, platforms stacked straight up like a list, large empty gaps between floors, exploded diagram with air between slabs, three disconnected floating islands, cutouts pasted one above another, odd mid-room crop, collage of separate renders, misaligned cameras per room, UI chrome, captions, watermarks, blurry, low-res, perspective vanishing-point photo

solo.label: Type 1 · Solo
solo.positive: ONE raised gray platform only, single complete room/chapter of the plant, big readable props, generous floor air on the platform, soft shadow under platform edge — reality check: the whole room stays meaningful if isolated
solo.negative: multiple platforms, stacked floors, second room visible, cropped mid-machine

stack.label: Type 2 · Stack master (floorplan puzzle)
stack.positive: ONE continuous facility laid out like rooms in a house / interlocking puzzle on the dark stage — platforms sit BESIDE each other (L-shape, courtyard, or staggered cluster), NOT in a vertical column. One or two complete rooms per platform. Slight careful overlap only where pieces share a wall or corner (puzzle tabs). Each room fully readable. Soft contact shadows. Digi-twin floorplan, not a skyscraper stack.
stack.negative: vertical list stack, three platforms centered one above the other, big vertical air bands, floating separated islands, mid-room crops that destroy meaning, heavy pasted overlap, duplicate rooms stacked, ladder of identical slabs

pipeline: Phase 1: generate 3 floorplan-puzzle masters (not towers); user picks ONE
Phase 2: slice along room seams that pass reality check — each piece stays a complete room
Phase 3: place from places.json so pieces reassemble the master with slight shared-edge overlap; hover tint
efficiency: Master must already look like a house floorplan / puzzle — never a vertical tower
Always emit 3 typed candidates before slicing; stop for user pick
Reality check every seam: if cropping a side/bottom makes the room lose meaning, move the seam
Overlap = thin shared wall/corner only — managed carefully, not odd pasted stacks
Store positive+negative per type and per candidate in this JSON; Phase 1 sidebar reads it
